query:
SELECT c.id, c.name, c.corporationId, co.firstName, co.lastName, co.jobTitle 
FROM companies c 
LEFT JOIN contacts co ON co.companyId = c.id 
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Robert Bosch%' 
ORDER BY c.name, co.lastName 
LIMIT 20
